audit.why: Lane difficulty is fairly framed: Neeko wins level 1 with 800-range Blooming Burst poke, Qiyana takes over from 2 onward with dashes vs an immobile mage. Content layer already says this; full-layer chart contradicted it (fixed in edits).
Spikes are right: lvl 3 (E joins), lvl 6 (R bursts her out of the telegraphed Pop Blossom leap), first item, 2+ items flank. spikes[] has all 4 entries.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d advise dodging Tangle-Barbs by standing behind minions. Riot's text says the tangle damages and roots everything it passes through, growing when it kills units or passes through champions — minions do NOT block it, they can empower it.
audit.why: Wrong mechanic shipped to a paying user gets them rooted.
audit.corrected: Dodge Tangle-Barbs sideways in the open; the wave feeds it. Also added real numbers: E 12s rank 1, W clone 16s, R 120/105/90s, and 'silence' removed (Neeko has no silence).

audit.why: 53.56% over 450 games, Qiyana-favoured, matches TRICKY-leaning-favoured framing.

audit.whatIsWrong: 17 misgendered fields (Neeko is she/her) and two copy-paste-bleed bullets; dosFull[1].t referenced a 'post-combo silence' Neeko does not have.
audit.corrected: All pronoun fields rewritten she/her; bleed bullets replaced with grounded bodies.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed across layers: content win[] = Neeko then Qiyana x6 (matches packet levelChart), full phases sides were Skill x5 with Neeko at 6 and 2+ items.
audit.why: Two answers rendered for the same row.
audit.corrected: All seven full-layer sides moved to match win[] (win[] already correct, so side edits alone), whys rewritten to match each verdict.

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs (Root): matchup-defining — The root sets up her whole burst — sidestep it behind minions. Check it before every step-up. - W Terrashape (element swap) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs (Root): 12s at rank 1 — it passes THROUGH minions and grows when it kills them, so dodge it sideways, never by hiding in the wave. Down means a full window. - Her W clone: 16s. - Pop Blossom: 120/105/90s — burst the channel before it lands.
